delivery.processing: No change to provider bytes. Runtime RGBE decode to floating RGB, no gamma conversion, resize or tone mapping; one mip-chain generation.

measured_source.preview: Reinhard per-channel display preview with linear-to-sRGB conversion. Not the delivery texture or a game capture.
measured_source.scope: Actual source decode and radiance only. No illumination, rendered game quality or photometric calibration is established.

lighting.panorama: Same cached material for background, ambient and reflection.
lighting.orientation: Brightest source texel centre in the pinned Godot equirectangular convention. No sky rotation or additional half-turn.
lighting.limits: Art defaults, not a physical-light calibration, weather or time-of-day mechanic.

fallback: Historical source rosters without this file retain the generated panorama. Present invalid input reports invalid, never ready.
limits: No desktop, game image, shadow capture, GPU performance or human production-quality verdict.
